- fixed a bug in the Cut gatherables mod allowing cutting flowers without the Doomsday DLC2, sorry - new Walkable Ark mod: Clear the walkable path of Ark containers on completion. - added another missing object to OCPD minimap mod and One hit objects mod - added Wolf death, Power Fist, Khopesh, Laser Sword to Sound muffler mod - changed Sound muffler mod to use volume values in xml files instead of a new audio file, when possible - changed all cliff vines to be indestructible and removed them from OCPD minimap mod and One hit objects mod
- added a missing object to OCPD minimap mod and One hit objects mod - added stars for mods for DLCs to the Options screen, and hidden mods for unpurchased DLCs
- fixed exploit in Restless crates mod
- fixed Reveal POIs mod showed POIs for DLCs you do not own, sorry
- fixed Mods UI prevented scrolling in the mod description

- fixed Bioweapon mod giving the correct amount calculated with the Material drop modifier - fixed a bug in Bioweapon mod not giving mana beads for stationary monsters - modified Bridge islands mod to use less way cpu

- changed Restless crates mod to only activate after the first crate opened, so the player gets what to do - changed Minimap extra mod to only show Night terrors after day 24 - modified the scale of Options UI to fit more content on the screen
- new Tabula Rasa farms mod: Adds 2 farmlands in the northwest and southeast corner of Tabula Rasa.

- new Big inventions mod: Enlarge icons on campfire invention screen to fill the empty space. - added 8 missing readables to the Second playthrough mod - modified Snowfall mod to spawn fewer particles, because other types of particles could not be drawn
- changed file format of xml file for Tips mod, added more support for translations

- fixed bug in mod UIs showing a message about OnEnter error - fixed a bug in Starting stage mod not giving pet control items when starting in Desolatum - changed damage threshold of the concrete bunker object from 95 to 96, so it aligns with all other concrete objects

- new Planter basics mod: Unlocks the Planter buildable and the Builder's Kit when completing the Farming Basics quest. - new Quest fixes mod: Various bugfixes for the quests. - new Did i dieded? mod: Keeps showing your death counter even if you did not die yet. - new Link gas leaks mod: Parent orphan gas clouds to their nearby pipes or barrels, so they will disappear.

- fixed Hide corpses mod for Underworld DLC1, it works with Mana Chambers now - fixed bug in Ostrich nests mod for nests overriding the default size - fixed a bug in Mark chunk mod did not allow to unmark - new Explode shards mod: Apply explosive damage to all mana prop shard objects in the world. - added some bosses to the Roll attack mod - added instant activation for enabling No stumps mod, no need to reload - added instant activation for Hide corpses mod, no need to reload - added all missing maps to Stage info mod - added readable signs to Second playthrough mod, all non-quest related signs are destructible by default

- fixed bug in Predator mod showing your own pets as animals - new Restless crates mod: Skip resting at the campfires to open timed crates, going near one is enough to reset the timer. - new Ostrich nests mod: Enlarge bird nests to make them more visible. - new Extract barrier mod: Blocks you from leaving the Law and Sword mech boss arenas without extracting the Fuel Cell. - added barrier and warning notification into Extract barrier mod for The First Expedition quest to investigate the pyramid - added a check for Wild crops mod to ignore newly tilled plant beds

- fixed bug in Reveal POIs mod and Yawning mod not remembering mod status in save - fixed bug in Predator mod when minimap rotation was on - fixed bug in Sleep timer mod and Automatic gasmask mod calculating with world time - added more checks for Flower Power mod to make the flowers gatherable as soon as possible - added starting the main DLC quest for Starting stage mod when the random location is in the DLC1/DLC2 map

- fixed bug in Hide corpses mod was still active in Underworld DLC1 - fixed Predator mod to not include Night Terrors - fixed a bug in Starting stage mod in the tomb with the link relay - fixed a bug in Ark elevator mod when you start the game in the Ark - fixed animal script overhead, Clone deer mod lag should be smaller - added a bit more randomness to the Snowfall mod

- removed Fall guardian mod, as it was never really up to quality - fixed a major bug in Ark single deposit mod - fixed bug in Predator mod, included flowers even without DLC2 - added a bush and the mushroom to the One hit objects mod - added farmables and generic searchable objects to the Easier gathering mod - added limiting Dog Houses to the Starting stage mod, to prevent break-out - changed Pickup mines mod to require item upgrade +2 - changed Flower Power mod to require Gathering skill - changed Snowfall mod to be always active - changed Keep running mod, now it is always disabled when touch controls are used, as that does not have the bug
- modified the volume of a lot of sounds in the Sound muffler mod, most got louder, but hitting sounds are even quieter - removed footsteps and generic ambient sounds from Sound muffler mod
- new Sound muffler mod: Lowers the volume of annoying or triggering sound effects by 5 to 20 dB, like object hitting sounds.

- new Snowfall mod: (optional) Immerse yourself in the winter landscape with drifting snow and howling winds. - new Capernaum shortcut mod: Open up the path to south by exploding the shipping container with barrels. - new Ark single deposit mod: Bulk dump the required number of materials into an Ark container. - added keys to the Minimap extra mod

- new Heavy keys mod: Ground flying key collectibles by increasing the gravity affecting it, so it won't get stuck at unreachable places. - new Bypass catacomb mod: Skip tracking back through the catacombs when you go from the Underworld to the main island. - merged Traps on minimap mod into Trap warning mod - merged Link Tower POI info mod + Obelisk POI info mod + Fishing Spot POI info mod + Buried Teleporter POI info mod into POI info mod - merged Compact statistics mod into Show statistics mod - merged Ark POI progress mod into Ark progress mod - changed Thick grid lines mod to be optional - added animation for Starting stage mod weapon collectable pick up - added mouse scroll wheel support to the Camera distance mod

- fixed bug that locked your save file because of DLC problems in Flower Power mod, i am so sorry. If you have a corrupted save file, DM it to me on Discord and i will fix it, you will not lose progress.

- fixed a bug in Minimap extra mod not hiding the destroyed searchables and picked flowers on the world map - fixed Yawning mod, now should only display the notification every 45 minutes - fixed a bug in several mods which used player modifiers was not activating for the co-op player - fixed a small bug in Starting stage mod was keep showing the tomb chest in the Fortress as searchable - changed Minimap extra mod to keep show Night Terrors on the world map after killed
- fixed a bug in Minimap extra mod, icons now hide on the world map on completion - added The Ark to the Starting stage mod with instant access to the Power Fist

- added King's Study on top of Crown to the Starting stage mod with instant access to the Escape Pod. Or not? - changed discovery radius of all objects in Minimap extra mod to 1000 - changed discovery radius of searchables with recipes to 500 in Minimap extra mod - modified the scrollbar size on some interfaces to make it more comfortable on Android

- added Night Terrors to the Minimap extra mod, they will now show up on the world map too - added recipes to the Minimap extra mod, objects with a recipe reward inside will now show up on the maps - added refiners to the world map - added flowers to the world map - added flowers back to Minimap extra mod - added diggables to Minimap extra mod - removed diggables from OCPD minimap mod

- fixed bug in Cut gatherables mod, made DLC2 quest flowers uncuttable - changed random location in Starting stage mod to be a random POI instead of just any map cell - changed Pet pointer mod to require crafting the Subterrean Sonar Toolkit - changed Pocket pets forever mod to scale with the upgrade level - changed Hunting knives mod to scale with upgrade level
- fixed bug in Wild crops mod

- new Trophies mod: Get a trophy after defeating bosses. You can place it your house as a buildable 3D object. - new Loudspeaker no friendly fire mod: No more accidental drive-by from your melee weapons, they cannot damage the Shelter loudspeakers. - new Hunting knives mod: Increases the damage dealt by knives against animals, to one-shot deer. - new Cut gatherables mod: Slash mushrooms, all berry bushes and flowers with melee weapons, don't have to pick them manually. - changed Easier gathering mod to be always active - added spice jars to Easier gathering mod - changed Target pets mod to be always active - changed Thick grid lines mod to be always active - changed Dodge cliffs mod to be always active - changed Wild crops mod to be always active - changed Fix from storage mod to be always active - removed Buried Teleporter icon mod, because not needed since Reveal teleports mod - changed Minimap extra mod to be always active - removed flowers from Minimap extra mod - added flowers to OCPD minimap mod - removed flowers from Predator mod - added gatherables to Predator mod - removed eggs from OCPD minimap mod - added eggs to Minimap extra mod - added mana beads to Predator mod
- added some protection to prevent publishing the sample mod to Steam - modified Track more mod to hide when on mobile UI

- fixed a bug in displaying Collector pets setting - new Booksmart pets mod: Ignore readable objects when pets are looking for what to attack. - new Fast weapon switch mod: Cycle your primary weapon tools without that short lag, switch to your 3rd tool faster. - new Tips mod: Showing tips for the mods on the loading screens. - added quests to the Track more mod - added a random location option for Starting stage mod, it might drop you in the sea, into the walls, or into unwinnable circumstances. You get 1 hour of temperature-immunity. - added Beam Gun in Pet Hub to Desolatum in Starting stage mod - changed how the Khopesh is given to the player in Starting stage mod

- new Reveal teleports mod: Break the ground where the Buried Teleporters are without the pets having to find them. - added the Tomb of the Immortal King to the Starting stage mod - fixed the pets vs the Keep running mod, probably?

- new Pocket pets forever mod: Upgrade the pocket ball to increase the time spawned pets are alive. To despawn them, rest at a campfire. - new Allow 99% POIs mod: Ignore the Underworld completion POIs when counting towards 100% achievement. - new Tall mushrooms mod: Raise mushroom gatherables higher above the ground to be more noticable. - fixed a bug in Indestructible buildables mod when disabling the mod flagged vanilla objects as destructible

- new Touchable refiner mod: Fix the add/remove buttons on the refiner UI being too small for mobile screens. - new Pet pointer mod: Shows the reward pet, recipe or dish for the Buried Teleports in the Pet Hub. - added Pets and Dungeons DLC3 Desolatum shelter to the Starting stage mod, you are locked in the pet maps until you complete the pet main quest - removed pets from the One hit objects mod, as turns out, pets work differently

- fixed the bug somewhat in Keep running mod with the pets using a workaround: re-equip the pet after loading - new Build on ground mod: Build Workbenches, Kitchen Stoves, Planters directly on the ground, without a platform. - new Code editor mod: Execute scripts with the help of a built-in code editor and documentation of the vanilla game. - new Mods UI tweaks mod: Better workflow for mod developers with a few small changes on the Mods UI. More compact and highlights important info. - new Console duplicates mod: Developer console does not hide duplicate lines any more, saving you to put NX_GetTime().tostring() on every line. - new Event Log mod: Replay the path you walked from the start with the vanilla Game Event Log on the Collection tab. - modified Event Log mod to not show on mobile UI, as the log is empty on Android - added support for mobile UI to the always-on section list, now using larger text - added support for mobile UI of the Camera distance modifier slider, now using smaller maximum - added warning text for Camera distance modifier mod when the Disable fog mod is not installed - added skulls and bones to the Thinner bushes mod - modified Map the shores mod to not run on small stages - modified OCPD minimap mod to not run on stages where the player is unarmed

- added pets to the One hit objects mod - modified Petting heals player mod to only apply for tamed deer and never pets - changed Petting heals player mod to be always active - changed Healing treat mod to be always active - changed Pick up mines mod to be always active - changed Grab material mod to be always active - changed Ark progress mod to be always active - changed Visible bushes mod to be always active - changed Thinner bushes mod to be always active - changed Walk over mortar pods mod to be always active - changed Automatic gas mask mod to be always active - changed Flower power mod to be always active
- fixed bug in OCPD minimap mod not showing gatherables, was a side effect of change introduced in v90.3.0
- new Reveal all POIs mod: (optional) Spoil the exploration and show all the points of interests on the current map.
- fixed bugs in new game mod options when closing and reopening the dialog did not activate the options - added check in OCPD minimap mod for skipping indestrucible and non-solid objects
- new Track more mod: (optional) Monitor more recipes on screen for the materials required.
- fixed Ark progress not showing until you do 1 collection
- new Accessible ramps mod: Walk onto Drawbridges and Piers from the side too.
- fixed bug in Ascend shelters mod where vanilla Loudspeaker would not react
- changed Collector pets mod area from a box to a sphere
- new Ascend shelter mod: Replay shelter horde mini-games with a buffed monster count after victory.
- added a short bullet time slow down to the Trap warning mod

- new Remind to extract mod: Notifies you to get the fuel cell after killing the mech bosses. - added Bear Traps support to Pickup mines mod - fixed Ark progress overlay was showing during cutscenes - changed Hide corpses mod to not run on Underworld DLC1 because of Mana Chambers
- added warning text for Keep running mod being incompatible with pets
- new Instant death mod: (optional) One hit kills you, you have 1 HP, so anyone can one-shot you.
- new Home Game+ mod: Starting shelter has a New Game+ respawner device when you are already in a New Game+, so you can restart easier.
- fixed some bugs in the Starting stage mod

- new Sane fabricator mod: Flower Power fabricator POI only requires the first level recipes to complete in Doomsday DLC2. - added some plants/rocks which blocked paths to an auto-destroy list for Preserve nature mod
- new Preserve nature mod: (optional) Keep all plants, bones and rocks indestructible when you start a new game.
- added shelters to Starting stage mod, you can begin your new game at other shelters - added info popups for the mods affecting new game, to the game start dialog
- new Starting stage mod: (optional) Begin your adventure right on the DLC1 Underworld or DLC2 Doomsday map, to increase challenge.
- fixed bug in One hit objects mod was hidden in the Options - changed Camera distance maximum value to farther - modified OCPD minimap mod to decrease lag spikes

- new Bioweapon mod: (optional) Exterminate all minions in a tower area if the tower is over +1 ascension level. Costs 50 potatoes. Helps with ascending all towers to +3. - changed interaction radius of Second playthrough mod to be smaller - changed a mod that used recipes to use temporary modifiers, works better with other mods and coop players

- new Second playthrough mod: (optional) Skip waiting for radios and audio logs to play, they are marked as listened just by getting near them. - new Don't track dishes mod: Disable tracking materials for dish recipes by default.
- added check for Dodge cliffs mod to not intervene when you are dodging into the bottom of a cliff - changed the color of interactable POIs that are also be destroyable in OCPD minimap mod
- new Dodge cliffs mod: (optional) Stop accidentally dodge rolling into the water off the cliffs because of the auto-targetting.
- added in-game event logging to some of the mods to help 10tons know why strange things happened in modded save files
- new Collapsible POIs mod: Hide link tower areas you are not interested in by clicking on the title on the Points of Interest screen of Collection tab.
- fixed a bug in Difficulty mod when starting New Game+ would not increase the difficult level by 1
- new Difficulty mod: Starting a new game allows you to set the cycle number, affecting enemy health, speed, damage and XP.
- new Wiki mod: Link wiki articles to a new button on information panels, etc. Playing in English gives you more specific links.
- new Show statistics mod: View your game statistics any time, not just after you completed the game. - new Compact statistics mod: Screenshot game statistics screen to one image to show off.
- new Unlimited builds mod: (optional) Increase build limit by 10000 objects to help you build your dream home. - fixed a bug in Collector pets mod where ignored materials were collected
- new Keys to home mod: Unlocks the starting shelter in New Game+ if you have the Crown from the previous run.

- new Grab material mod: (optional) Pick up ignored materials manually when auto-collect is disabled on them. - removed Friendly doors mod, as sometimes you could pass closed doors, and i couldn't fix it - fixed a bug in Camera distance mod when it would not initialize if the HUD was disabled - added warning text for Clone deer mod, because it causes lag spikes
- added hard blocking for incompatible mods
- new Free camera mod: (optional) Move the main camera freely to take screenshots from any perspective.
- new Flower Power mod: (optional) Enables collecting exotic flowers.
- fixed compatibility with DLCX mod by XYB88 - fixed bugs with chinese localized labels sometimes not translating
- added UI rescale for Mobile UI
- new Fix from storage mod: (optional) Activate Ropebridges, Terminals, Obelisks, Mana Chambers, Wishing Wells with materials from your Campfire Storage Box.
- fixed a bug in Friendly doors mod

- new One hit objects mod: (optional) Dismantle everything in just one hit using any weapon passing the damage threshold of the object. - moved Automatic attack mod to Cheats modpack, as it turns out, it might attack faster than the normal button hold does. - fixed a bug in OCPD minimap mod, when the POIs disappeared
- fixed a bug in Controller shared library - moved Mods UI mod to Developer tools modpack
- added package box icon to distinguish modded tools, buttons, interactions - added another button to access the Change Log from the Options screen
- renamed Toggle attack mod to Automatic attack mod, because the attack speed is not vanilla
- added Cooking Recipes and Flower Power recipes to the New game++ mod
- new New game++ mod: Pick additional tools, weapons, features you want to carry over to your New Game Plus.
- added collapsible groupings to the Options page for the mods

- new OCPD minimap mod: (optional) Remaining destroyable/searchable/usable/gatherable/diggable objects are marked on the minimap. Accessibility mod for people having OCPD Obsessive-compulsive personality disorder.
- new Friendly doors mod: (optional) Opened doors are less annoying, you won't get stuck behind them when you try to exit a room.

- new Wild crops mod: (optional) Neglected plant beds have a chance to get a wild crop grow randomly, so you can not lock yourself out of inventing dishes. - new Remember the seed mod: Re-equiping your seed bags restores your last selected farming seed.

- added Ark level 4 material collection to Ark progress mods - changed Ark progress mods to hide undiscovered material types - changed Fishing spot POI mod to hide undiscovered fish types and hide all for unfished spots - modified Petting heals player mod to require Animal Friend level 3 skill - updated to game version 1.4.0.38
- fixed bugs in Yawning mod
- new Ark elevator mod: Save walking all the way down and up in the Ark, you can select the destination floor in elevators.

- removed DLC fast travel mod, as since Confirm pills mod exists, it is not needed anymore - changed Yawning mod notification cooldown from 45 real world seconds to 9 real world minutes - modified Yawning mod to be an always active mod - changed Predator mod compass sizes

- new Save material transporter mod: Do not use up your Material Transporter item when your backpack is empty. - added mobile UI button for Toggle attack mod - added confirm popup for Unstuck mod - modified Sleep timer mod to calculate with time modifier trinkets
- added mobile UI to the Change Log, and removed vanilla block on all platforms, so you can see the changes on Android too

- new Yawning mod: (optional) Yawn when you are ready to sleep, remembers you every 15 in-game minutes. - new Sleep timer mod: Shows remaining real world time until you can sleep again, on the campfire screen.

- new Thinner bushes mod: (optional) Pass over every type of undergrowth, skulls and bones, you won't get stuck in a bushy area.

- new Toggle attack mod: (optional) Enable continuous attack with a custom keypress. Accessibility mod if you have repetitive strain injury or a mobility impairment.
